input.summary: Narrow mutual non-solicit to 12 months from end of involvement and add general-advertising / unsolicited-approach carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] We can accept a mutual non-solicit, but only for twelve months measured from the end of the individual's involvement in the Services rather than the term plus a year, and it must carve out general advertisements and unsolicited approaches.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination
ops.newText: for twelve (12) months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement with the Services

ops.text: The foregoing restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other solicitations not specifically directed at the other party's personnel, or to responses to unsolicited approaches by such personnel.
